title: BSE margin basket (Finspot OMS, Margin Basket)
purpose: The margin percentage Finspot charges per BSE scrip for one product basket. First line: 'BSE Margin Basket', the product code (I = MIS, C = CNC, H = CO, M = NRML, B = BO) and the basket name; then one line per scrip with a BSE scrip code (from the BSE scrip and series file) among the previous business day's equity securities: scrip code and margin percentage = VaR + extreme loss margin, never below the firm's minimum. Product, basket name and minimum percentage are firm settings in Connections → Finspot uploads (I, BSEMIS and 20 by default).
source: Finspot File_Formats.xlsx, sheet Margin Basket (header 'BSE Margin Basket|I|BSEMIS'; BSE scrip code, margin percentage; delimiter |)
